notes.title: Update 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Hello, Bravelanders!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/18c2f2b6be94c672b48167a41c3383a5917bc951.png

The new Knights of Braveland update is on its way! Heroes and items from two new DLCs will appear in the game: Around the World Pack and Fantastic Beasts Pack. Keep in mind that the new items are not included in the 100% completion. It means that if you didn't buy the DLC, you can still reach 100% by collecting only the basic items, but after the purchase the limit is extended, and you can continue collecting.

There will be new portraits in the Guild Hall - get ready to meet Werewolf, Ogre, and Crab King, new bosses that will be added soon!

We're also working on the balance of Arcade Mode. You will now be able to buy and pick up food, which in this mode instantly replenishes 5% of your max health.

Thanks to your feedback, we have identified and fixed many bugs. For example, the Guild Leader will now be positioned lower so as not to prevent you from accessing the library, and the Skeleton King will no longer skip his final phase.

Best regards,
Tortuga Team.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/0daa6246760eaed26aea9b66067d653fbc28b6cb.png

Hi, Bravelanders!

We have fresh update for you. We have made some tweaks and fix crucial bugs.

Co-op with keyboard + gamepad
You can play local co-op with 2 players using keyboard and gamepad. Earlier you could only play it with 2 gamepads.

Game difficulty decreased
We have analysed game progress of players and easened it for Rookie and Fighter difficulty. New difficulty grade Berserk also added.

Cloud saves fixed
We have detected and fixed the issue with cloud saves. Now you could play on different devices on Steam.

Achievements progress fixed 
We have detected bugs and fixed achievemnts Crusher II, Crusher III, Trickster III and Rich III.

Invulnerability while resurrecting
It seems unfair to be resurrected just find yourself under attack of bunch of enemies. That's why we have added invulnerability period after resurrection.

Player stagger reworked
We have detected some issues with player stagger. Now player will have no damage for a short time after being hit.

Emotes fixed
Some strange bug occurs when you use emotes in game. We have fixed faces of heroes so now everything is ok.

Wish you a good play!

notes.title: Big update of Demo version!
notes.notes:
Hello, Bravelanders!

After the Steam festival, we got a lot of feedback from players, and this gave us some ideas on how to improve the game. We weren’t wasting our time and decided not only to rework some old mechanics but add new content too. This is what we will talk about next.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/b01d5b5ae60e9b2bfb6d5e5299eb5d335f90ab4a.png

The first ideas that came from our players related to making the Hall more lively. Here we decided to add NPCs: neutral characters who participate in dialogues with our hero. The Head of the Guild in the game hall will make it more alive, and will also give us the opportunity to add various atmospheric dialogues with our heroes in the near future. What other characters would you suggest to put in the hall? We'll be happy to read your ideas in the comments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/4f15d78f62cd471727b8404e7589f05341d746aa.png

The second part of the feedback concerned the leveling of heroes in the hall. In a four-player game, there are not enough resources for all players to improve their stats. Therefore, we reworked the upgrading system to global buffs that affect all squad members. The starting equipment of each hero can also be improved separately, but at later stages. So the balance of costs is shifted towards global upgrades: improving the efficiency of elixirs, sets of random equipment from a blacksmith, the ability to receive tools from a chest, and so on. All this will make our new boss raids more effective, and the way to the main villain will be a little bit easier too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/9cfdf0a82a8305f9148c373c7ad064db92221c80.png

After studying a lot of Let’s Plays, we also decided to diversify the set of dropped items in the game. Some weapons and gadgets from the main version have been added to the demo.
Let's talk about them a little more:


 Peasant pitchfork is useful not only for close combat, but also to inflict an insidious blow by ramming at several enemies. But keep in mind that your ability to maneuver at time of ramming is somewhat limited.
 Throwing knives and axes are effective not only at close range, but also allow you to strike at a distance. This can help out in some tactical situations.
 The staff is capable of inflicting damage with the energy of nature. Use it wisely and try not to get too far from Hogwarts.
 Traps add some pretty unusual mechanics. Now you can lure enemies into cleverly placed traps to inflict great damage to them.
 Pistols are excellent weapons, effective at medium range. Hit a group of enemies with the cloud of your buckshot. Yarr!
 And, of course, noticed the flask of flammable liquid. A burning field will cause a lot of trouble to enemies. And that satisfying sound of breaking the glass bottle will bring back pleasant memories of beloved Castlevania games.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/a28899f62934308fce5f443f73a2ac87e9b366b6.png

And, as a bonus, we will show you the art of another inhabitant of the Hall - the Magician. He will take care of you and your knights. Before each new raid, the Magician will prepare random potions and all kinds of magic bonuses for your adventure. You never know what he will prepare next time, but it will definitely help you in a critical situation. This character will appear in the beta version too, which we will start sending out soon. You can sign up for the beta testing right now and we will inform you when it will be available.
